title: 第一卷 第18章 大客户
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
张海洋说道：“我帮你找朋友问问。”

    荣光飞递烟：“靓仔，谢谢啦，怎么称呼？”

    张海洋：“张海洋，这是我的联系方式。”

    他递了张名片。

    荣光飞接过来，回了一张。

    张海洋收起名片：“我去打电话。”

    老陈嗤笑道：“荣老板，你还真是病急乱投医啊。”

    “你看看这小子嘴上都没几撮毛，还是个生瓜蛋子，都没认识几个人，哪有本事帮你哟。”

    张海洋呛声：“老陈，我是年轻，还是个新手。”

    “你倒是老行家，不也只能干瞪眼。”

    老陈被怼的吹胡子瞪眼：“你小子还教训我了！”

    张海洋没搭理他，走去打电话。

    老陈喊道：“荣老板，你看看，这小子什么德行。”

    荣光飞没接茬。

    他看出来老陈和张海洋有矛盾。

    但懒得理会。

    没多久。

    张海洋走回来，摇摇头说道：“不好意思啊荣老板，都没有海参，一时半会也弄不到。”

    他挺郁闷的。

    这可是发财的机会。

    结果只能眼睁睁的看着，占不到半点便宜。

    可惜了了。

    荣光飞要绝望了。

    他根本没多少时间能周旋，开席的时间可没法缓，他长叹一声：“唉，这回算是栽了……”

    张海洋：“渔港那边去了吗？”

    荣光飞点点头。

    他已经不知道打了多少电话，把能找到的人脉都找了个遍，还安排了人去渔港盯着。

    他还试着和主家沟通，用养殖的。

    主家不乐意。

    说要么这道菜不上，要么上，就得用野生的。

    虽然没说什么狠话，但话里话外的意思，都是警告他，要是宴席没摆好，落了人家的颜面，那他这个饭店以后也别开了。

    老陈走过来，说道：“荣老板，我就说这小子指望不上吧，你还是再想想别的办法。”

    “人家来找你帮忙，你不帮忙也就算了，还说风凉话，有意思不？”张海洋竖了个中指。

    自从他收李华的那批蛏子，老陈就看他不爽，哪怕他说了不少好话，老陈也不接受。

    既然如此，那还受你个鸟气。

    张海洋是年轻，但也不是个怂人，不然也不会拿了全部身家投入到这个收购的行当里来。

    老陈气的骂街。
content_en:
Zhang Haiyang said: "I'll ask a friend for you."

    Rongguang handed over the cigarette: "Thank you, handsome boy. What do you call me?"

    Zhang Haiyang: "Zhang Haiyang, this is my contact information."

    He handed over a business card.

    Rong Guangfei took it and replied with one.

    Zhang Haiyang put away his business card: "I'm going to make a call."

    Old Chen sneered and said, "Boss Rong, you are really in a hurry and seek medical treatment."

    "Look at this kid, he doesn't even have a few hairs on his mouth. He's just a bastard. He doesn't know many people. How can he help you?"

    Zhang Haiyang choked: "Old Chen, I am young and a novice."

    "You are an experienced expert, so you can only stare."

    Lao Chen was stunned and glared: "You kid taught me a lesson!"

    Zhang Haiyang ignored him and went to make a phone call.

    Lao Chen shouted: "Boss Rong, look at what kind of virtue this guy has."

    Rong Guangfei didn't answer.

    He saw that there was a conflict between Lao Chen and Zhang Haiyang.

    But too lazy to pay attention.

    It didn't take long.

    Zhang Haiyang came back, shook his head and said, "I'm sorry, Boss Rong, we don't have any sea cucumbers, I won't be able to get them for a while."

    He was quite depressed.

    This is an opportunity to make a fortune.

    As a result, I can only watch helplessly, and I can't get the slightest advantage.

    What a pity.

    Rong Guangfei was desperate.

    He didn't have much time to deal with it, and there was no way to delay the opening of the banquet. He sighed: "Oh, I'm in trouble this time..."

    Zhang Haiyang: "Have you gone to the fishing port?"

    Rong Guangfei nodded.

    He had made countless calls, searched all the contacts he could find, and arranged for people to go to the fishing port to keep an eye on him.

    He also tried to communicate with the owner and used farmed ones.

    The owner is not happy.

    He said that either this dish would not be served, or if it was served, it would have to be wild.

    Although he didn't say any harsh words, the underlying meaning behind his words was to warn him that if the banquet was not arranged and he was embarrassed, he would not open this restaurant in the future.

    Lao Chen came over and said, "Boss Rong, I'm just saying that this guy can't be counted on. You'd better think of another way."

    "When people come to you for help, it's okay if you don't help, and they still make sarcastic remarks. Isn't that interesting?" Zhang Haiyang raised his middle finger.

    Ever since he collected Li Hua's batch of razor clams, Lao Chen had been unhappy with him. Even if he said a lot of good things, Lao Chen would not accept it.

    If that's the case, then I'm sorry for you.

    Zhang Haiyang is young, but he is not a coward, otherwise he would not have invested all his wealth in this acquisition business.

    Lao Chen cursed angrily.
